data.one_liner: A set of cryptographic hashing functions implemented in pure Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides common cryptographic hashing algorithms including MD5, RIPEMD-160, SHA-1, SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, and HMAC. Implemented entirely in pure Dart with no external dependencies.
use_when: You need to compute MD5, RIPEMD-160, or various SHA hash digests in pure Dart
You want to generate HMAC message authentication codes
You want a hashing library with zero third-party dependencies
avoid_when: You already use package:crypto for your hashing needs
strengths: Pure Dart implementation with no dependencies
Supports a wide range of standard hashing algorithms (MD5, RIPEMD-160, SHA-1 through SHA-512, HMAC)
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic README code snippets
Minimal ecosystem adoption compared to older established alternatives

alternatives.name: crypto
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is the standard, well-tested cryptographic hashing library maintained by the Dart team.
